ffmpeg.exe — сборка FFmpeg 9.0.2 для Local VOT (только то, что нужно программе).
ffmpeg.exe — FFmpeg 9.0.2 built for Local VOT (only what the app needs).

FFmpeg: https://ffmpeg.org
Исходники / source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
  sha256 8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e
Как собрано / how it was built: scripts/build-ffmpeg.sh
  https://github.com/SolidSnake1765/local-vot/blob/main/scripts/build-ffmpeg.sh
Библиотеки (статически) / libraries (static), from MSYS2 packages (https://packages.msys2.org):
  x264 (GPL v2+), LAME (LGPL v2+), Opus (BSD), zlib (zlib license), mingw-w64 runtime.
